newsitem.title: USA: Top Source sees Q4 charge of $350,000.
newsitem.headline: Top Source sees Q4 charge of $350,000.

text.p: Top Source Technologies Inc said Monday that it has completed a company-wide restructuring, which will result in a net one-time charge to earnings of approximately $350,000 in the fourth quarter of 1997.
Top Source added that the restructuring will result in operating cost savings of more than $2.0 million annually.

The company made the announcement when it released third-quarter earnings, which were $10,803 or $0.00 per share, on revenue of $5,767,620. This compares to a loss of $674,511 or $0.02 per share, on revenue of $4,684,684 in the year-eralier period.
The company said that sales from its former United Testing Group subsidiary, a discontinued operation, have been excluded from 1996 and 1997 revenue totals for comparative purposes.

Top Source makes the patented On-Site Oil Analyzer, an "oil analysis laboratory in a box," proprietary Overhead Sound Systems, and the patented ARCS Safety Seat, a seat track design which causes the seat itself to become a passive restraint in severe frontal collisions.
